meta.name: InfiniteCounterModule
meta.label: Infinite Counter
meta.description: Infinite number counter system for your server (Free & Strict modes).

main.label: Main Configuration
main.description: Configure the counter channel and mode.

channel_id.label: Counter Channel
channel_id.description: The text channel for the counter.

type.label: Counter Mode
type.description: Select the counter mode for your server.

free.label: Free Counter Settings
free.description: Users write the numbers themselves in the chat.

restart_on_error.label: Restart on Error
restart_on_error.description: Reset the counter to 0 if a user makes a mistake.

allow_chat.label: Allow Chat
allow_chat.description: Allow regular chat messages alongside numbers.

strict.label: Strict Counter Settings
strict.description: The bot handles counting via an interactive panel button.

send_panel.label: Send Panel
send_panel.description: Send or update the panel message with the button in the channel.

trad.error_desc: A wrong number was sent. The counter has been reset to **0**.
trad.error_double_click: You cannot count twice in a row!
trad.leaderboard_empty: No members have participated in the counter on this server yet!
